name: Maxx
source: Is able to control himself in any situation and think for himself. But the transition to another world influenced him… How? He haven’t not understood this yet. Is this Maxx, that recently stepped resolutely into the teleport camera, or had his body just remained the same? There is no answer to this question. And who knows how the our iron warrior will behave now…
